tasks.instruction: The blue tiger leans out from behind a tall wooden bookshelf, extending one arm toward the viewer with its palm open and fingers spread, as if offering a small brass key held between thumb and forefinger; warm library light and dusty shelves frame the gesture.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, slightly low angle, arm foreshortened toward lens
tasks.visibility_requirement: the offered palm and all five fingers are clearly unobstructed and facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 从书架后探身，单手掌心朝前递出钥匙，展示五指

tasks.instruction: From a cramped attic crouch, the blue tiger pushes open a slanted skylight with one upturned palm flat against the glass, fingers splayed and bending slightly under the pressure; rafter shadows stripe the raised forearm and ceiling.
tasks.camera: medium shot from below, tilted dutch angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: palm pressed to glass is fully visible with all five fingers distinct against the pane
tasks.intent_zh: 阁楼里用掌心推开天窗，五指张开承压

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger balances on a narrow steel beam, one arm thrust sideways for counterweight with the palm turned up and fingers spread wide, while a high-rise skyline tilts behind; the other arm is tucked out of frame.
tasks.camera: wide composition, low angle looking up along the beam
tasks.visibility_requirement: counterweight palm faces upward and every finger is separated and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 钢梁上单臂张开掌心朝上保持平衡

tasks.instruction: Reaching down into a rain barrel, the blue tiger stops with one hand just above the water, palm open and fingers spread as droplets leap up toward the pads; the forearm and cupped hand are silhouetted against dark ripples.
tasks.camera: top-down close shot, barrel rim framing the hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: the hovering palm faces upward with all five fingers clearly visible above the water
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身伸手到雨桶上方，掌心朝上接水珠

tasks.instruction: Half-turned on a potter's wheel, the blue tiger presses one wet palm onto clay to center it, fingers spread and slightly curled, splashes of slip on the forearm; motion blur rings the spinning bowl beneath the hand.
tasks.camera: close-up over-the-shoulder from the side
tasks.visibility_requirement: the clay-pressing palm is unobstructed, fingers spread and countable
tasks.intent_zh: 拉坯机上掌心压泥，五指张开定型

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a dune and holds one palm flat above the sand, fingers spread, while a tiny fennec fox noses the palm; the long shadow of the raised arm stretches across ripples at golden hour.
tasks.camera: low side shot at sand level, backlit
tasks.visibility_requirement: the flat palm and all five fingers are silhouetted and clearly separated
tasks.intent_zh: 沙丘上掌心摊平让耳廓狐嗅闻，五指分明

tasks.instruction: Leaning across a billiard table, the blue tiger plants one open palm on the green felt for support, fingers spread wide beside a cluster of balls; the cue arm stays hidden while the hand anchored in frame dominates the foreground.
tasks.camera: low table-level close-up, wide angle
tasks.visibility_requirement: the supporting palm lies flat and fully visible on the felt with all five fingers spread
tasks.intent_zh: 俯身台球桌，单掌撑在绿呢上五指张开

tasks.instruction: On a windswept cliff, the blue tiger holds one palm out flat to feel the gusts, fingers spread and trembling slightly, while a kite string wraps around the wrist and the sea churns far below; the pose leans into the wind.
tasks.camera: medium wide shot from the side, strong horizon line
tasks.visibility_requirement: the wind-facing palm is flat and fully visible with five separated fingers
tasks.intent_zh: 悬崖边单手迎风摊开感受气流，五指张开

tasks.instruction: Kneeling at a rooftop beehive, the blue tiger slides one bare palm into a gap, palm up and fingers spread, while bees crawl across the fingers; the veil of a suit is pushed back so the hand is fully exposed.
tasks.camera: close-up slightly above, hand centered
tasks.visibility_requirement: the palm inside the hive gap is open and all five fingers visible despite crawling bees
tasks.intent_zh: 屋顶蜂箱旁单手伸入，掌心朝上让蜜蜂爬过

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a rocky stream bank, one open palm hovering just above the surface as a trout leaps toward it, fingers spread and glistening; splash droplets arc between palm and fish in the foreground.
tasks.camera: tight low angle near water, fast shutter feel
tasks.visibility_requirement: the waiting palm is fully visible and every finger distinct against the water spray
tasks.intent_zh: 溪边蹲伏，掌心朝上等待鳟鱼跃入

tasks.instruction: Reclined on a moving handcar, the blue tiger thrusts one open palm flat against the tunnel ceiling to gauge clearance, fingers splayed and bending; a lantern clips to the other wrist while streaks of tunnel wall blur past.
tasks.camera: low upward shot inside the tunnel
tasks.visibility_requirement: the ceiling-pressing palm is flat and all five fingers clearly spread
tasks.intent_zh: 轨道车上躺姿用掌心抵住隧道顶测量高度

tasks.instruction: Perched atop a lighthouse ladder, the blue tiger extends one palm outward to catch a drifting feather, fingers spread and slightly cupped; the curved lens room and spinning lamp glow behind the open hand.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, spiral staircase background
tasks.visibility_requirement: the outstretched palm is open and all five fingers are visible around the feather
tasks.intent_zh: 灯塔梯子上单手摊开去接飘落的羽毛

tasks.instruction: Squatting before a fogged bakery window, the blue tiger presses one palm flat onto the glass, fingers spread and leaving prints; loaves and steam glow inside, and the reflected muzzle overlaps the hand.
tasks.camera: close frontal shot, reflection layered on the glass
tasks.visibility_requirement: the glass-pressed palm is fully visible with five spread fingers and prints
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在起雾的橱窗前用掌心压玻璃，五指留印

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on a canvas of wet paint, one open palm lifted toward the ceiling as if halting the light, fingers spread and daubed with color; the studio floor around the sprawled legs is a swirl of pigments.
tasks.camera: top-down wide shot, body diagonal in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: the lifted palm faces the camera fully with all five painted fingers distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在颜料画布上单掌朝上，五指染满颜色

tasks.instruction: While hammering a nail into a fence post, the blue tiger holds the nail with one open palm flat against the wood, fingers spread for the hit; the other arm mid-swing is cropped at the frame edge.
tasks.camera: side close shot, fence rails converging
tasks.visibility_requirement: the bracing palm is flat on the post and all five fingers clearly spread
tasks.intent_zh: 修栅栏时单掌按木桩固定钉子，五指张开

tasks.instruction: Half-submerged in a hot spring, the blue tiger rests one open palm flat on a mossy boulder, fingers spread for balance; steam curls around the raised forearm while the other arm and lower body are out of view.
tasks.camera: side medium shot, steam softening the boulder edge
tasks.visibility_requirement: the boulder-planted palm is visible and all five fingers clearly spread
tasks.intent_zh: 温泉中单掌按住长满苔藓的石头稳住身体

tasks.instruction: Climbing a sandstone chimney, the blue tiger smears one open palm high on the rock face, fingers spread and chalked white; the other arm and feet are outside the crop while red canyon walls fill the background.
tasks.camera: steep low angle, rock crack framing the hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: the high palm is fully visible on the rock with all five chalked fingers spread
tasks.intent_zh: 砂岩裂缝中攀爬，单手抹粉按在岩壁上

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches on a dock and extends one open palm over the edge, fingers spread, as a curious seal pops its head up toward the hand; cold morning light catches water droplets between them.
tasks.camera: low wide shot from the water side
tasks.visibility_requirement: the extended palm is open and all five fingers visible above the seal
tasks.intent_zh: 码头边蹲下伸手，海豹探头靠近掌心

tasks.instruction: Leaning out of a train window, the blue tiger presses one open palm flat into the rushing wind, fingers spread and streaming backward; blurred countryside and a scarf snapping past complete the frame.
tasks.camera: side profile close-up at the window
tasks.visibility_requirement: the wind-swept palm is flat and all five fingers clearly spread against the blur
tasks.intent_zh: 列车窗外单掌伸入疾风，五指被吹展

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged among floating lanterns, the blue tiger holds one palm face-down above a paper lantern, fingers spread, as if sensing its heat; the reflection of the hand shivers on the river surface.
tasks.camera: top-down medium shot over the water
tasks.visibility_requirement: the hovering palm is open and all five fingers clearly spread above the lantern
tasks.intent_zh: 盘坐河面灯间，单掌悬于灯笼上方探热

tasks.instruction: At a rainy bus stop, the blue tiger tilts a broken umbrella with one open palm pressed beneath the fabric to prop it up, fingers spread and wet; rain sheets across the illuminated sign behind the upraised hand.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, neon sign bokeh background
tasks.visibility_requirement: the palm under the umbrella fabric is visible and all five fingers distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 雨夜公交站，单掌撑起破伞布，五指顶住

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches beside a garden hose and holds one open palm beneath the nozzle, fingers spread to test the spray; water fans between the fingers while sunlight throws a rainbow across the wet forearm.
tasks.camera: close-up, rainbow arcs across frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: the water-catching palm faces up with all five fingers clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 花园水龙头下摊开掌心试水温，水从指间流过

tasks.instruction: On a rooftop at dusk, the blue tiger holds one palm open toward a hovering drone that lowers a small parcel onto it, fingers steady and spread; city lights glitter below the outstretched arm.
tasks.camera: low angle looking up past the hand to the drone
tasks.visibility_requirement: the receiving palm is open and facing up with all five fingers clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 屋顶黄昏，单手摊开迎接无人机投下包裹

tasks.instruction: Kneeling in a dusty archive, the blue tiger slides one open palm under a fragile parchment map, fingers spread flat to lift it; dust motes swirl in the lamp beam above the careful hand.
tasks.camera: close overhead shot, parchment filling lower frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: the palm beneath the parchment is visible along its edge with all five fingers spread
tasks.intent_zh: 档案室里单掌托起脆弱的羊皮纸地图，五指平展

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sprawls on a snowy slope and thrusts one open palm upward from the drift, fingers spread and dusted with snow, as if signaling a rescue; a distant mountain ridge lines the horizon.
tasks.camera: high angle looking down the slope
tasks.visibility_requirement: the snow-buried palm emerges with all five fingers clearly spread and visible
tasks.intent_zh: 雪坡上躺卧，单掌从雪中伸出张开求援

tasks.instruction: Hanging upside down from a jungle vine, the blue tiger grips with one palm wrapped around it while the other open palm presses flat to a tree trunk, fingers spread; the hand on bark is the focal point of the inverted composition.
tasks.camera: upside-down medium shot, trunk diagonal
tasks.visibility_requirement: the bark-pressing palm is fully visible with five spread fingers, vine hand cropped out
tasks.intent_zh: 倒挂藤蔓，单掌按在树干上，五指张开

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger crouches inside a glass-blowing workshop, one open palm cupped near a glowing molten blob on the end of a pipe, fingers spread to judge the heat; orange light rims the hand against the dark shed.
tasks.camera: close-up side shot, molten glow lighting the palm
tasks.visibility_requirement: the cupped palm is open and all five fingers clearly visible near the molten glass
tasks.intent_zh: 玻璃作坊里单掌靠近熔融玻璃感受温度

tasks.instruction: At a forest mushroom ring, the blue tiger kneels and rests one open palm flat on the moss, fingers spread and barely touching a tiny glowing mushroom; the other arm is cropped, and fireflies drift above the palm.
tasks.camera: macro low shot, mushrooms in foreground bokeh
tasks.visibility_requirement: the moss-resting palm is flat and all five fingers clearly spread
tasks.intent_zh: 森林蘑菇圈中跪地，单掌平放苔藓上，五指轻触发光蘑菇

tasks.instruction: Leaning over a rooftop pigeon coop, the blue tiger extends one open palm flat with seed, fingers spread, as pigeons land on the hand and wrist; the railing and rooftops blur behind the crowded palm.
tasks.camera: medium close-up, birds overlapping the hand
tasks.visibility_requirement: the seed-filled palm is open with all five fingers visible beneath landing birds
tasks.intent_zh: 屋顶鸽舍边摊开掌心喂食，鸽子落在手上

tasks.instruction: Sliding down a fire pole, the blue tiger keeps one bare palm flat against the brass surface, fingers spread for drag, while the other arm is out of the crop; the pole and stripes blur with downward motion.
tasks.camera: low vertical shot looking up the pole
tasks.visibility_requirement: the palm flat on the pole is visible with all five fingers spread and distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 沿消防杆下滑，单掌贴铜杆增加摩擦，五指张开
